entry.name: providerOrder
entry.label: Ordered list of provider IDs for compact and full views.

entry.name: claudeVisible
entry.label: Whether Claude is shown in the widget.

entry.name: umansVisible
entry.label: Whether Umans is shown in the widget.

entry.name: codexVisible
entry.label: Whether Codex is shown in the widget.

entry.name: claudeWindow
entry.label: Selected Claude usage window ID for the compact line. Empty uses the primary window.

entry.name: codexWindow
entry.label: Selected Codex usage window ID for the compact line. Empty uses the primary window.

entry.name: displayMode
entry.label: Compact representation mode: icons, text, or icons+text.

entry.name: separator
entry.label: Separator glyph between compact provider entries.

entry.name: fontScale
entry.label: Compact font scale multiplier (1.0 = theme default size).

entry.name: showCountdown
entry.label: Whether reset countdowns are shown in the full representation.

entry.name: refreshIntervalMinutes
entry.label: Global refresh interval in minutes. Enforced floor is 5 (Claude-safe TTL).

entry.name: cautionThreshold
entry.label: Utilization percent at which the caution threshold applies (must be less than critical).

entry.name: criticalThreshold
entry.label: Utilization percent at which the critical threshold applies.
